title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to hide/disable New, Edit (Edit List), and Delete actions on the page
summary: This post explains two methods to hide or disable the New, Edit (Edit List), and Delete actions in Business Central pages: using permission sets to exclude Insert, Modify, and Delete permissions, or setting the InsertAllowed, ModifyAllowed, and DeleteAllowed properties (available in BC25 wave 2 for page extensions).
key_points: New, Edit (Edit List) and Delete are not defined in AL code; they map to Insert, Modify and Delete permissions on Table Data
Excluding those permissions in a permission set grays the actions out on list and card pages, but the New action in drop-down lists stays visible and raises a permission error when clicked

Setting InsertAllowed, ModifyAllowed and DeleteAllowed to false removes the actions; before BC25 (runtime 13) this only worked on custom pages, and from runtime 14 page extensions can change them on standard pages
For a list page with a card page, change the card page; for a list without a card page, change the list itself; for drop-down lists, change the page that opens when New is clicked
These properties cannot be set from variables, so the author suggests using profiles to give different users different behavior

quotes.text: From Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25), we can modify these three properties in pageextension.
quotes.why_it_matters: This marks a significant capability change that enables hiding these actions on standard pages without custom code on the page itself
